relationships.subject: PT3
relationships.evidence_quote: co-treatment of vincristine and PT3 (15 mg/kg, i.p.) prevented the development of vincristine-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: PT3
relationships.evidence_quote: the co-treatment with PT3 significantly reduced the number of infiltrated M1 macrophages (CD80+) and increased M2 macrophages (CD163+) in the sciatic nerves

relationships.subject: PT3
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-α) and increased expression of anti-inflammatory cytokine (IL-10) in both the sciatic nerve and DRG

key_findings: HDAC3 activity increased in DRG in a vincristine neuropathy model.
Selective HDAC3 inhibition with PT3 shifted macrophages from M1 to M2, lowered IL-6/TNF-alpha and prevented neuropathy.
